title: The Share of a Resort Lodging Retention That Is Charged Where a Claim Stands
content:
What is charged in the end on a Resort Lodging retention turns on the protection written over the stay, because a household whose claim the collective has allowed does not also bear the nights. The records read are the household's protection plans under Pass and Trip Protection: their standing, the holding each is written over, and the claim decision each carries.

Where a protection plan standing active over the reservation carries a claim decision standing allowed, the allowed claim share of the room rate and occupancy retained is charged, being 0 percent of it.

Where a protection plan standing active over the reservation carries a claim decision standing under assessment, the open claim share of that amount is charged, being 50 percent of it, and the rest stands against the plan.

Where no protection plan standing active over the reservation carries either decision, the whole of that amount is charged.

| What the protection records show | The share charged |
| --- | --- |
| A plan standing active over this reservation, claim decision standing allowed | 0 percent of the amount retained |
| A plan standing active over this reservation, claim decision standing under assessment | 50 percent of it, the rest standing against the plan |
| No plan standing active over this reservation carrying either decision | the whole of it |

### Three hypothetical reservations, where the room rate and occupancy retained come to 1500.00 USD

A plan standing active over the reservation with a claim decision standing allowed gives 0 USD charged, being 0 percent of 1500.00 USD.

A plan standing active over the reservation with a claim decision standing under assessment gives 750.00 USD charged, being 50 percent of 1500.00 USD, and the remaining 750.00 USD stands against the plan.

A reservation over which no protection plan stands active carrying either decision has the whole 1500.00 USD charged; and a plan standing active over a different holding of the household is not a plan standing active over this reservation.
